title: Android Conversion
seo: Android app onboarding and paywall optimization
meta: Fix the drop-off between install and first use with clearer onboarding, upgrade screens and prompts. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Android conversion, from installs to regular users
overview: Installs only matter if people come back. We trace what a new user sees from the first launch to the first win, then improve onboarding, the upgrade screen and the main buttons. We set up event tracking so you can see where people leave. Prompts for notifications and ratings follow Google Play policy, and no change promises a set result.

faq: Will this raise my subscription numbers?
We cannot promise numbers. Results depend on your product, price and traffic. We remove clear friction and add tracking so you can measure the effect of each change.
Do you follow Google Play rules on subscriptions and prompts?
Yes. We follow Google Play policies on billing, subscription disclosures, notifications and deceptive design. We do not use fake timers, hidden prices or forced sign-ups.
Firebase Analytics is the usual choice, but we can use the tool you already have. We add only the events we agree on, and help you update the Data safety form in Play Console to match.
Does the app need real users first?
The screens can be improved now, but real drop-off data needs traffic. If you are pre-launch, we add the tracking and a plan to read the numbers after launch.
